name: authoring-lab
title_zh: 改模拟器实验先看 simulator.yaml 再动
tagline_zh: 改实验说明、命令行为、终端、控件、种子文件或 CI，不用翻遍整个仓库。
tagline_en: Edit Simspace lab docs, command scenarios, terminals, controls, seed files, or CI without spelunking the whole.
desc_en: Author or edit this Simspace lab — add or change instruction sections (markdown), command behaviour (scenarios in simulator.yaml), terminals, controls, seed files, or CI. Use whenever creating lab content, wiring up a new command or agent prompt, or before committing lab changes.
why_zh: 把分散在 markdown、YAML、CI 里的实验内容当成一张可编辑的图来改，而不是逐文件搜索。
why_en: Treats a lab as one editable graph instead of scattered files. Starts from simulator.yaml scenarios, then updates markdown and.
limit_zh: 只认 Simspace 实验仓库结构，且仓库里得有 simulator.yaml。它不生成新实验，只改已有内容。
limit_en: Only for Simspace lab repos with a simulator.yaml. Edits existing labs, doesn't scaffold new ones. No runtime validation; CI support limited to.
title_en: Lab editor that reads simulator.yaml before touching.
